rules.name: enrolld:read_slo_burn:ratio1m
rules.query: clamp_min(1 - (sum by (job) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",job="enrolld",le="0.05",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[1m])) or on (job) (0 * enrolld:read_requests:rate1m)) / enrolld:read_requests:rate1m, 0) / 0.01

rules.name: enrolld:read_slo_burn:ratio5m
rules.query: clamp_min(1 - (sum by (job) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",job="enrolld",le="0.05",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[5m])) or on (job) (0 * enrolld:read_requests:rate5m)) / enrolld:read_requests:rate5m, 0) / 0.01

rules.name: EnrolldReadSLOBurnRateHigh
rules.query: (enrolld:read_slo_burn:ratio5m > 14.4) and on (job) (enrolld:read_slo_burn:ratio1m > 14.4) and on (job) (enrolld:read_requests:rate1m > 1) and on (job) (min by (job) (up{job="enrolld"}) == 1)

annotations.description: 99% 的读请求应成功且在 50ms 内完成；1m 和 5m 燃烧率均超过 14.4 持续 30s，当前 5m 燃烧率为 {{ printf "%.2f" $value }}。先查 RED，再查连接池等待和 CPU。
annotations.summary: enrolld 读路径 SLO 错误预算燃烧过快
